subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the 2011 population census?

options.text: The literacy rate in the country as per the Census of 2011 is 78 per cent.
Sex ratio is defined as the number of males per 1000 females in the population.
Kerala has a sex ratio of 1046.
A person aged 7 years and above, who can read and write with understanding in any language, is treated as literate.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the 2011 population census, a person **aged 7 years and above, who can read and write with understanding in any language, is treated as literate.**
 
• **The 2011 population census** was conducted in **India, aiming to gather demographic data and other relevant information about the population.**
 
• The census covered various aspects, including** population size, growth rate, literacy rate, sex ratio, and other socio-economic indicators**.
 
• It provided valuable insights into the population distribution across different **states, districts, and cities within the country.**
 
• The census data helped in understanding **trends, patterns, and disparities in terms of population, literacy, education, employment, and other important factors.**
 
• It served as a crucial tool for** policy-making, planning development initiatives, and resource allocation at national, state, and local levels.**
 
• The census was conducted through a **door-to-door survey method, collecting data from households and individuals to ensure comprehensive coverage of the population.**
